recipient: one current authorized workspace member responsible for this environment; never tenant end users
dispatch_guard: GET the environment's /api/v1/onboarding using a signin:read credential bound to that environment. Recheck membership and communication preferences through their authoritative sources; any unavailable check defers sending.
blockers: Engage run goals and exits must correlate project_id and environment_id, not only the company/contact
Engage must recheck current goal, recipient authorization, support pause and consent immediately before dispatch
Resolve platform-root identities through a verified Engage source; never join a different issuer by email
Configure brand, verified sending domain, preferences, finite frequency caps and scoped resume links
Verify live Assistant knowledge sync, signed onboarding tool and human handoff on the candidate deployment

journeys.stop: goal_first_sign_in = true in the same scope, including completion by a teammate; or goal inapplicable, opt-out, removed access or deleted/suspended resource
journeys.pause: related support open, snooze, quiet hours or frequency cap
journeys.subject: Connect your app's first login
journeys.body: Your app is created. The next step is to sign in through it and check the callback. Continue where you left off; the guide also explains how to preserve existing users.

timing: first observed incomplete-to-complete transition after enrollment
journeys.stop: already sent for this goal version and scope, opt-out or removed access
journeys.subject: Your app issued its first sign-in token
journeys.body: Cbox ID observed a person token or session for your app. Next, verify local account mapping, logout and organization access in your application. This milestone does not certify production readiness.

journeys.prerequisite: goal_first_sign_in = true and goal_create_organization = true and SSO relevant to selected use case
timing: after first value and outside the reminder sequence
journeys.stop: goal_connect_sso = true, feature dismissed/not applicable, opt-out or removed access
journeys.subject: Let a customer use their workplace login
journeys.body: Your business customers can use Microsoft Entra, Okta or another workplace identity provider. This is SSO. Configure it for one customer organization while other customers keep their own login methods.
